description: Stop tracking competitors on a website, 1 to 25 per call, by id from get_competitors, as the Competitors page's delete does. Returns one result per id, in order: removed, no_change (already removed), or not_found (not a competitor of this website). Past mentions and citations are kept, and a removed competitor can be restored on the Competitors page. Reanalyzing past responses happens only when someone runs the backfill on the Competitors page, which costs credits; this tool never starts it and costs no credits.

competitor_ids.description: The competitors to stop tracking, by id from get_competitors.

name: remove_competitors
